CommunityApplications.Profile: Noah Rijkaard (OriginalByteMe on GitHub), a senior full-stack engineer in Kuala Lumpur. I maintain unofficial Unraid templates and Docker images for coding-agent tools: Orca (onorca.dev), Stably's open-source app for running coding agents in parallel git worktrees, and T3 Code (t3.codes), the open-source control surface for coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode. I'm not affiliated with Stably or T3 Tools Inc.: report problems with a container on the originalbyteme-unraid-apps GitHub issues, and problems with the apps themselves at github.com/stablyai/orca or github.com/pingdotgg/t3code. More about me at [noahrijkaard.com](https://noahrijkaard.com).
